pass_rule: Each case returns at least one question, an empty assumptions list, and no acceptance criterion that fills missing_field from a guess.

cases.brief: The client wants a dashboard of fleet status.
Users should manage fleet status quickly. Make the page feel modern.
Add login. Vendors should see costs. The later note says vendors must not see costs.
When a part fails inspection, show something useful to the technician.
Store the inspection results for later.
Build the maintenance page like the other pages.
On the call they asked for PDF export. The email from the client says Excel only.
Make search better for the parts catalog.
Pull the latest orders from the client's system into the work order screen.
Ship the status page and the export page. They said status is first unless the demo needs export.
